intro: Tourism and fishing are the Maldives' main industries.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Over a million tourists a year stay at 'one island, one resort' hotels with overwater villas.

chapters.title: Fishing
text: Tuna is caught by pole and line, one fish at a time, which protects stocks.

keyTerms.meaning: Fishing one fish at a time with a rod.

cardGroups.title: Made in the Maldives
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Maldives makes and sells to the world.
